# mv: convert method with unnamed receiver to func (adds _ for unnamed)
mv T.M F
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func (T) M(n int) int { return n }

func G() int {
	var t T
	return t.M(1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func (T) M(n int) int { return n }
+func F(_ T, n int) int { return n }

 func G() int {
 	var t T
-	return t.M(1)
+	return F(t, 1)
 }
